name: source-file-links
goal: Source lists actual files with revision-pinned GitHub links and a modal button for each file

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Source tab must list concrete files only, linking each to the selected GitHub commit and opening that file in the shared modal. Feature specification updated.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing Reports entity-preview-source and Desktop entity-source-code scenarios asserted one entity action and accepted metadata. Strengthened those scenarios and snapshot fixtures with per-file links, encoded paths, directory ownership and direct second-file opening.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Committed test checkpoint 7e8d8dc63 fails with the missing Source files list and per-file actions. Immutable record 3bb3932c9753512563c88fbda0c8469a006f17b76db0f6cdc3ae8417253941f8; inspected paired Source screenshot.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
